title: Fix C 64-bit MIC LLSec encoding
description: C frame serialization currently ORs the full MIC mask for 64-bit MICs, producing reserved LLSec bits and frames rejected by parsers. Encode the MIC-length enum value correctly and add a valid 64-bit write/parse round-trip test.
close_reason: LLSec selector encoding verified correct against spec/02-physical-link.md §4.2 bit table + committed mic_length_selector.json vectors (LICHEN_MIC_32=0/LICHEN_MIC_64=1 enum values = wire bits 2-4; LLSec byte 0x04 for selector-1 broadcast). Added two host-harness tests to lichen/tests/frame/main.c: full write→parse round-trip asserting encoded LLSec byte 0x04 and mic_length preservation, plus canonical selector-1 vector parse. frame_test 16/16 pass.
